cases.why: ملی sends from the four digits its cards start with, and writes بانك/ملي with Arabic letters. It states interest as «سود:…+» — a word no direction list has — so the message carries no delta and only the مانده is read; that is a stated balance, not a guess, so it must not come back inferred. The trailing «0425-01:15» is a date with no slash in it and must be read as neither an account number nor a printed date.
